title: Amounts Owed on the Covered Holding and Set Against a Protection Payout
content:
What the household still owes on the holding a Pass and Trip Protection plan is written over is also set
against what a claim pays, read from that holding's own record and account under the Season Pass Programme.

1. Where the covered holding's account carries an instalment the payment method refused in the season, the
   amount so refused is set against what the claim pays.
2. Where no instalment was refused on that account in the season and the covered holding still carries a
   balance to be collected, that balance is set against what the claim pays.
3. In every other case nothing is set against on this ground.

**Which figure is taken.** On the first the figure is the total of the instalments the payment method refused
on the covered holding's account within the season the plan covers. On the second it is the balance still to
be collected standing on the covered holding's own record. A refused instalment in the season shuts out the
second altogether, even where a balance also stands; and a balance is taken only where it stands above
nothing.

**Illustrations (hypothetical inputs).** A covered holding whose account shows one instalment of 210.00 USD
refused in the season and a balance still to be collected of 420.00 USD: 210.00 USD is set against what the
claim pays and the balance is not. The same holding with no refused instalment in the season and the same
balance standing: 420.00 USD is set against. A holding with no refused instalment and no balance to be
collected: nothing is set against the payout on this ground.
